title: ProposeTradesOutput
description: Structured output for an AI agent's daily trading decisions. Every trade must include a stop-loss level.

trades.description: List of proposed trades for today. Empty array means HOLD (no action).

action.description: BUY to open/add to a LONG position. SELL to close/reduce a LONG position. SHORT to open/add to a SHORT position. COVER to close/reduce a SHORT position.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, SPY, QQQ). Must be a US stock or ETF. Penny stocks allowed.

allocation_pct.description: For BUY/SHORT: percentage of total portfolio value to allocate (5-25%). For SELL/COVER: percentage of the position to close (use 100 to close entirely).

order_type.description: MARKET: execute at next open. LIMIT: execute only if price <= limit_price.

limit_price.description: Required if order_type is LIMIT. The maximum price you are willing to pay (BUY/COVER) or minimum price to accept (SELL/SHORT).

stop_loss_pct.description: For BUY: percentage below entry price to set the stop-loss (e.g., 10 means stop at -10%). For SHORT: percentage ABOVE entry price (a short loses money as price rises). System-enforced, non-overridable.

take_profit_pct.description: Optional. For BUY: percentage above entry to take profit. For SHORT: percentage BELOW entry to take profit (a short profits as price falls).

reason.description: Brief explanation of the trade thesis. Used for strategy adherence analysis.

daily_notes.description: Brief market outlook and portfolio commentary for the day. Helps track strategic consistency.

portfolio_review.description: Optional review of existing positions. Note any positions you considered selling but decided to hold.

action.description: HOLD: keeping position. WATCH: monitoring closely for potential exit.
